name: Aermetric
description: Precision aerial data and analytics platform for infrastructure and land management.
tagline: Predictive maintenance for aviation, powered by AI
longDescription:
Aermetric offers a cloud-based predictive maintenance platform specifically designed for the aviation industry. Their platform leverages big data and AI to provide real-time monitoring and predictive analytics for aircraft maintenance, helping airlines reduce downtime and improve operational efficiency.

At Evolution, we see immense value in Aermetric's innovative approach to transforming the aviation industry. Their focus on utilizing advanced technology to solve critical industry challenges aligns with our commitment to supporting companies that drive meaningful change and innovation.

team.name: Derek Waterman
team.title: Founder & CEO
team.bio: Derek leads Aermetric with over two decades of experience in technology and entrepreneurship. He has a distinguished track record in developing data-driven solutions and previously played a pivotal role in pioneering predictive search engine algorithms, and served as a director at a $1.3 billion publicly traded company.

team.name: Sean Bushkov
team.title: President & CTO
team.bio: A seasoned aerospace engineer with over 12 years of experience from Boeing Defense, NASA, and United Airlines, where he served as a Subject Matter Expert in fleet engineering and tech services. His expertise in reliability and predictive maintenance shapes Aermetric's cutting-edge solutions.

team.name: Roger Lehman
team.title: Board Member
team.bio: With more than 35 years in the aviation and aerospace sectors, Roger provides strategic oversight at Aermetric. As Managing Partner at Oliver Wyman, he specializes in inorganic growth and acquisitions across the Americas, encompassing aviation MRO, operations analytics, and aerospace aftermarket services.

team.name: Eunhwan Yoo
team.title: Data Scientist
team.bio: Eunhwan brings 7 years of data science expertise with previous roles at United Airlines and Meta. At Aermetric he focuses on leveraging advanced data analytics to enhance the reliability and safety of aircraft operations.

team.name: Nick Sachon
team.title: Operations
team.bio: A veteran of the US Navy with over 20 years of experience as an aviator and officer. His deep background in aviation operations, program management, and project management ensures Aermetric's operational processes are robust, efficient, and aligned with industry best practices.

name: Allos
description: Transforming how healthcare organizations manage and optimize clinical workflows.
tagline: Causal AI bringing generic drugs to market faster
longDescription:
Allos leverages its proprietary Causal AI platform to bring generic versions of complex drugs to market, addressing an $88B opportunity. Their approach reduces drug development costs by 40% and focuses on securing FDA exclusivity for complex generics.

By 2030, hundreds of drugs will go off-patent, and Allos' strategy helps pharmaceutical companies tackle the high costs and risks associated with developing these generics.

At Evolution, we recognize the value of Allos' innovative use of AI to address critical challenges in the pharmaceutical industry. Their focus on leveraging advanced technology to solve industry-wide issues aligns with our commitment to investing in companies that drive meaningful change and innovation.

team.name: Aditya Varna Iyer, PhD
team.title: CEO
team.bio: Aditya brings a rich blend of scientific expertise and leadership to Allos. With a DPhil from Oxford and machine learning work at CERN, he drives Allos' mission to revolutionize complex drug development using AI, combining cutting-edge technology with pharmaceutical innovation.

team.name: Isaac To
team.title: COO
team.bio: Isaac leverages broad experience in operational strategy, having worked for Walt Disney Imagineering and the Hospital Authority of Hong Kong. His deep understanding of complex systems keeps Allos operating efficiently while scaling its mission of reducing drug development costs.

team.name: Balasubramanian (Balu) Krishnamurthy
team.title: Chief Pharmaceutical Officer
team.bio: Balu brings decades of pharmaceutical expertise, having developed and launched over 50 complex generics. Formerly with Aurobindo Pharma, his deep knowledge in pharmaceutical science complements Allos' technology-driven approach to solving cost and efficacy challenges.

team.name: Ivano Lodato, PhD
team.title: Chief Scientist
team.bio: Ivano holds a PhD from the University of Utrecht with previous experience at Fudan University. He spearheads the integration of AI into Allos' drug development process, optimizing the accuracy and success rates of clinical trials for complex generics.

name: Arovia
description: Portable display technology bringing large-screen experiences to any environment.
tagline: Portable pop-up displays for on-the-go productivity
longDescription:
Arovia specializes in developing innovative portable display solutions. Their flagship product, the Spontaneous Pop-up Display (SPUD), is a collapsible, lightweight, high-resolution screen that expands to provide users with a larger display for on-the-go productivity and entertainment.

At Evolution, we recognize Arovia's commitment to redefining mobile workspaces with their cutting-edge display technology. Their focus on creating portable, high-quality visual solutions resonates with our mission to back companies that are pushing the boundaries of innovation.

team.name: Alex Wesley
team.title: Co-Founder & CEO
team.bio: Alex was an MBA student at Rice University when he initiated the idea for SPUD (Spontaneous Pop-Up Display). His entrepreneurial spirit secured significant crowdfunding and investment for Arovia, driving the company from concept to market success.

team.name: George Zhu
team.title: Co-Founder & CTO
team.bio: George holds a Mechanical Engineering degree from Rice University, graduating in the top 3 of his class. The technical brain behind SPUD, his expertise in product design — honed in Shenzhen, China — brought Arovia's collapsible display concept to life.

name: Bekonix
description: Smart workplace connectivity solutions that bridge physical and digital operations.
tagline: No-code platform for IoT and connected device development
longDescription:
Bekonix is a no-code platform that enables users to design, prototype, and deploy connected devices and IoT solutions with ease. By offering an array of user-friendly tools and templates, Bekonix streamlines the process for creators, engineers, and entrepreneurs, allowing them to transform innovative ideas into functional smart products without the need for coding expertise.

At Evolution, we recognize the significance of Bekonix's mission to make IoT development accessible to a wider audience. By lowering the barriers to entry for creating connected devices, Bekonix is fostering a new wave of innovation that aligns with our commitment to supporting companies driving technological progress and empowerment.
founders: Daniel Kaye, Jyoti Das, Ken Turcotte

team.name: Daniel Kaye
team.title: Co-Founder & CEO
team.bio: Daniel leads Bekonix's mission to simplify smart technology development using their no-code platform. He has a background in developing over 100 tech products, contributing to the growth of consumer electronics and video spaces.

team.name: Jyoti Das
team.title: Co-Founder & President
team.bio: Jyoti has over two decades of experience in high-tech leadership, responsible for product, marketing, and operations. Prior to Bekonix, he held senior roles at IBM and Intel, focusing on IoT and Big Data strategies.

team.name: Ken Turcotte
team.title: Co-Founder & CTO
team.bio: Ken oversees the technical development of Bekonix's no-code platform. He has a long history of contributions to the tech world, including work on the revolutionary Video Toaster, and ensures the technological backbone of the company's product offerings.

team.name: Chris Davey
team.title: Chief Design Officer
team.bio: Chris oversees product design and user experience at Bekonix. His focus is on making the platform intuitive and easy to use, supporting the company's goal of democratizing smart tech creation.

team.name: Debbie English-Deason
team.title: Director of OCS
team.bio: Debbie leads the Operational Customer Support team at Bekonix, ensuring customers have a seamless experience on the platform. Her work focuses on optimizing customer success and operational processes.

team.name: Richard Wardlow
team.title: Director of Hardware Engineering
team.bio: Richard oversees hardware engineering at Bekonix, focusing on the integration of smart technologies with physical hardware. His expertise is crucial for bridging the gap between software and hardware within the Bekonix ecosystem.

team.name: Nicole Shuman
team.title: Product Manager
team.bio: Nicole manages product development at Bekonix, coordinating between engineering and marketing teams. Her role ensures that product releases align with customer needs and market trends, continuously evolving the platform.

team.name: Joshua Armonio
team.title: Growth Manager
team.bio: Joshua drives Bekonix's expansion and customer base as Growth Manager. His efforts are centered around business development and scaling Bekonix's platform to grow the company's market presence.

name: Cartwheel
description: Simplifying payments and financial operations for modern businesses.
tagline: Automated accounts receivables for staffing agencies
longDescription:
Cartwheel is a cutting-edge platform designed to simplify and automate accounts receivables management for staffing agencies. By leveraging advanced technology, Cartwheel streamlines cash flow processes, reducing administrative burdens and optimizing payment cycles. Its mission is to empower staffing agencies to focus more on their core operations by automating key financial workflows, improving efficiency, and enhancing overall financial health.

At Evolution, we see significant potential in Cartwheel's innovative approach to automating accounts receivables for staffing agencies. Their focus on simplifying cash flow management and improving payment cycles addresses a critical need within the staffing industry.

team.name: Mani Themadathil
team.title: CEO & Co-Founder
team.bio: Mani has a strong background in product leadership, having served as Chief Product Officer at a rapidly growing startup where he frequently collaborated with staffing agencies. Those experiences inspired him to co-found Cartwheel, revolutionizing accounts receivables through automation.

team.name: Stephen Wigginton
team.title: Co-Founder & CTO
team.bio: Stephen brings firsthand experience with the operational challenges staffing agencies face. Together with Mani, he co-founded Cartwheel to streamline and automate receivables processes, helping staffing companies manage their cash flow more effectively.

name: Cash Abroad
description: Stablecoin-powered cross-border payment rails cutting FX costs from 6% to ~1.5% for SMEs in industrial and logistics markets.
tagline: Global treasury operations for the next era of trade
longDescription:
CashAbroad enables global treasury operations for SMEs in industrial and logistics markets using stablecoin-based payment rails. Today, SMEs lose up to 6% in FX conversion costs and time delays due to inefficient financial systems. CashAbroad reduces this to ~1.5%, while enabling multi-account operations, faster expansion, and cross-border settlement in under two hours through local partners in eight countries. The company is initially focused on the $900B+ U.S.–Mexico trade payments market, one of the most active trade corridors in the world. By turning supply chains into programmable financial engines, CashAbroad unlocks efficiency that compounds into growth, sustainability, resilience, and shared economic abundance.

At Evolution, we're excited by Cash Abroad's bold reimagining of international money movement in an era where global commerce demands speed and simplicity. By leveraging digital wallet infrastructure, real-time currency conversion, and multi-currency accounts designed for international trade, they've built a platform that brings enterprise-grade FX capabilities to businesses that have long been underserved by traditional banks.
founders: Ruth Gomez Hidalgo, Braulio Alejandro Ramirez Montiel

team.name: Ruth Gomez Hidalgo
team.title: Co-Founder & CEO
team.bio: Ruth is the CEO and co-founder of CashAbroad, a financial technology company transforming cross-border trade payments with fast, compliant, and cost-effective digital dollar solutions for exporters and importers in Latin America. With deep expertise in technology, finance, and innovation, she specializes in blockchain, AI-driven financial solutions, and programmable financial infrastructure. She has been part of DraperU x Stellar Embark Accelerator and Techstars Payments, actively shaping the future of digital finance.

team.name: Braulio Alejandro Ramirez Montiel
team.title: Co-Founder & CTO
team.bio: Braulio is the CTO and co-founder of CashAbroad, building the technical infrastructure that powers the future of global trade finance. With a background in physics engineering and international finance, he combines deep expertise in software development, cloud architecture, and blockchain. He previously led innovation initiatives at Telmex and digital product growth at Walmart. As an active contributor to the Stellar ecosystem and alumnus of DraperU x Stellar Embark Accelerator and Techstars Payments, he leads CashAbroad's technical vision.

name: Ciao Pappy
description: Modern Italian-American pantry brand reimagining the $4.5B pasta sauce market with chef-crafted, clean-label sauces.
tagline: Premium pasta sauces with Italian roots and California soul
longDescription:
Ciao Pappy is a modern Italian-American pantry brand reimagining the $4.5B U.S. pasta sauce market with chef-crafted, clean-label sauces inspired by the Italian and California coast. Founded to meet growing demand for premium, clean, and culturally resonant pantry staples, our sauces bridge tradition and innovation in a category long dominated by legacy brands. With a distinct voice, West Coast spirit, and bold flavors, Ciao Pappy modernizes pantry classics and adds an accent to your pantry staples.

At Evolution, we backed Ciao Pappy for their refreshing take on a pantry staple that's long overdue for reinvention. By blending the richness of Italian heritage with the brightness of California cuisine, they've created a line of premium sauces that stand out in both flavor and brand voice. Their chef-driven approach, early traction within a discerning niche, and modern vision for clean-label convenience position them as a compelling force in the future of everyday cooking.

team.name: Francesca Pittaluga
team.title: Founder & CEO
team.bio: Francesca is the founder of Ciao Pappy, a modern Italian-American pantry brand inspired by her Italian father and their shared love of cooking. After a 14-year career in fashion marketing and communications for luxury brands, she launched Ciao Pappy to bring premium, clean-label sauces to a category dominated by outdated, mass-market players. With deep roots in Italian culture and a passion for thoughtful brand building, Francesca is reimagining the pantry for today's home cook with a West Coast ease and modern touch.

name: Cleona
description: Reimagining the maternal health journey with personalized support and resources for pregnancy and postpartum.
tagline: Personalized maternal care for every birthing individual
longDescription:
Cleona is reimagining the maternal health journey by offering personalized support and resources to guide families through pregnancy and postpartum. Their platform addresses critical gaps in care, especially in underserved communities, empowering users to access local services and essential knowledge quickly. With a focus on reducing preventable maternal deaths, Cleona is committed to making healthier, safer experiences the norm for every birthing individual.

At Evolution, we value Cleona's mission to reshape maternal healthcare by offering accessible, personalized support to those who need it most. Their efforts to empower communities and improve reproductive outcomes align with our commitment to fostering innovation that drives positive social change.

team.name: Ashley Street
team.title: Co-Founder & CEO
team.bio: Ashley is passionate about transforming maternal care, particularly for marginalized communities. With a background in strategic management, she co-founded Cleona to tackle the maternal health crisis in the U.S. Ashley is an alumna of Georgetown University and draws on her experience in public health to lead Cleona's mission for equitable care.

team.name: Sacha Taylor
team.title: Co-Founder & COO
team.bio: Sacha brings deep operational expertise to Cleona, managing the platform's day-to-day operations. She has a background in technology and has worked in leadership roles across various sectors. Together with Ashley, Sacha envisions Cleona as a transformative platform that empowers women and ensures safe, personalized care for all mothers.

name: CoreImpact
description: Smart EMG-sensor garments delivering real-time muscle activity data to athletes, coaches, and trainers.
tagline: Wearable technology that rewrites athletic performance
longDescription:
Core Impact Inc. is a cutting-edge company revolutionizing athletic performance through innovative wearable technology. We specialize in developing and manufacturing smart garments embedded with advanced EMG (electromyography) sensors. These sensors capture real-time muscle activity data, providing athletes and coaches with unparalleled insights into performance, biomechanics, and injury prevention.

Founded by a former professional baseball player with a deep understanding of the challenges athletes face, Core Impact is based in Elk Grove, CA. The company is proud to be backed by and used by elite athletes — including MLB superstar Mookie Betts, who believes in their vision and trains with their system.

At Evolution, we recognize the transformative potential of Core Impact's technology in reshaping sports training and performance. By combining EMG sensor technology with AI-driven insights, Core Impact equips athletes and coaches with real-time feedback to enhance decision-making and maximize results.

team.name: Samuel Taylor
team.title: Co-Founder & CEO
team.bio: Samuel is the co-founder and CEO of Core Impact, bringing firsthand knowledge of elite athletic performance as a former professional baseball player. He built Core Impact to solve the performance and injury challenges he experienced firsthand, creating wearable EMG technology that gives athletes and coaches real-time muscle data to train smarter and prevent injury.

name: Companion Candles
description: The first premium, pet-safe fragrance brand — toxin-free candles that protect the animals who share your home.
tagline: Premium home fragrance that's safe for every member of the family
longDescription:
Companion Candles is the first premium, pet-safe fragrance brand. We've transformed the way we feed our pets — fresh food, supplements, specialty treats — but no one is talking about what they breathe all day, every day. Traditional candles and home fragrance products release 250+ toxins (carcinogens, endocrine disruptors, respiratory irritants) that settle onto floors, beds, and couches — exactly where pets spend their time. This can cause dermatitis and severe respiratory reactions. Pet parents who scrutinize every kibble ingredient unknowingly expose their animals to dangerous airborne toxins. Most importantly, a portion of every sale supports animal rescue organizations.

At Evolution, we see Companion Candles as a category-defining brand at the intersection of pet care and clean living. Founded by a former growth marketing leader with a passion for animal advocacy, the company is redefining home fragrance with products free of the 250+ toxins most harmful to pets and humans. By combining a proprietary coconut-soy wax blend, FSC-certified wood wicks, and essential-oil-based fragrances, Companion Candles delivers a premium, design-forward alternative to traditional candles.

team.name: Loren Lewin
team.title: Co-Founder & CEO
team.bio: With a background in growth marketing at Grubhub and SpotHero, Loren brings deep expertise in scaling consumer brands. As a dedicated animal welfare advocate and board member of The Anti-Cruelty Society, she founded Companion Candles to create a safer, toxin-free home environment for pets and their families.

name: Dapper Boi
description: Gender-neutral apparel built for every body type — style, comfort, and inclusivity without compromise.
tagline: Fashion that transcends gender norms
longDescription:
Dapper Boi is an apparel company specializing in gender-neutral clothing that offers a blend of style, comfort, and inclusivity. Their products cater to a wide range of body types and identities, aiming to redefine fashion by providing versatile clothing options that transcend traditional gender norms.

At Evolution, we recognize the significant cultural impact of Dapper Boi's mission to make fashion more inclusive. Their dedication to filling a gap in the market aligns with our investment philosophy of supporting companies that champion diversity and innovation while addressing consumer needs in a meaningful way.

team.name: Vicky Pasche
team.title: CEO & Co-Founder
team.bio: Vicky co-founded Dapper Boi in 2015, driven by her frustration with the lack of inclusive fashion that catered to her body type and aesthetic. With no prior experience in fashion, she launched the brand with a mission to break gender norms and provide body-inclusive clothing. Her leadership has taken Dapper Boi from a successful Kickstarter launch to becoming a brand known for empowering people to feel confident through gender-neutral and affordable clothing.

team.name: Charisse Pasche
team.title: COO & Co-Founder
team.bio: Charisse is the co-founder and Chief Operating Officer of Dapper Boi, holding a background in organizational management and business psychology. She has been instrumental in managing operations and scaling the company, ensuring the brand's commitment to inclusivity and customer engagement. Charisse also played a key role in the brand's crowdfunding efforts, helping Dapper Boi grow while staying connected to its community of supporters.

name: Daxe
description: AI-powered search with 98% accuracy — eliminating hallucinations and data security risks for pharma, finance, and government.
tagline: Structured Semantic Search that sets a new standard for AI retrieval
longDescription:
Daxe offers an AI-powered search platform designed to improve the accuracy and efficiency of data retrieval in industries where precision is critical, such as pharmaceuticals, finance, and government. Their solution boasts 98% accuracy and tackles common issues like AI "hallucinations" and data security concerns. By utilizing a graph database, Daxe ensures rapid, accurate searches across large datasets, helping businesses easily locate critical information.

At Evolution, we value Daxe's cutting-edge Structured Semantic Search (SSS) technology, which sets a new standard for AI retrieval. Their innovative approach to managing unstructured data provides unmatched accuracy, empowering companies to make data-driven decisions with confidence. Daxe's flexible deployment options also ensure a broad range of organizations can benefit from this powerful technology.

team.name: Erika Bahr
team.title: Founder & CEO
team.bio: Erika brings a wealth of experience in developing large-scale data systems, having worked with Fortune 500 companies. She managed $25 million in ad spend data quarterly and led a proof-of-concept project with AWS focused on real-time market forecasting using machine learning. Her expertise in handling complex data systems is key to Daxe's advanced AI-powered platform.

team.name: Barak Michener
team.title: CTO
team.bio: Barak has a distinguished background in AI and data technology. At Google, he played a pivotal role in developing the Knowledge Graph, revolutionizing search capabilities, and led the development of Mapgraph at Lyft, transforming mapping services. His innovative contributions to AI technologies are reflected in several patents he holds, making him a valuable leader at Daxe.

team.name: Avery Lyford
team.title: Software and Services Executive
team.bio: Avery has a long track record of success as a CEO and Chief Customer Officer, with experience in delivering enterprise software solutions to some of the world's largest companies. His expertise spans creating and executing winning strategies for software and services. With a master's degree in computer science, he has deep technical knowledge that helps drive Daxe's business innovation.

team.name: James Costantini
team.title: Growth and GTM Expert
team.bio: James is a multi-exited founder with a strong background in scaling companies to hundreds of millions in revenue. Known for his growth hacking expertise and go-to-market strategies, he brings invaluable skills to Daxe's expansion efforts. His proven track record in scaling startups highlights his ability to take Daxe to new heights.

name: Dope Dog
description: Premium CBD-infused pet wellness products — treats, oils, and grooming items lab-tested for purity and effectiveness.
tagline: Bringing relief and comfort to dogs everywhere
longDescription:
Dope Dog is a pet wellness brand that specializes in CBD-infused products designed to improve the health and well-being of dogs. Their product line includes treats, oils, and grooming items formulated to help alleviate anxiety, joint pain, and other common ailments in dogs. Dope Dog prioritizes quality and safety, using premium ingredients that are lab-tested to ensure purity and effectiveness.

At Evolution, we recognize Dope Dog's commitment to enhancing the lives of pets through their innovative use of CBD products. Their focus on developing safe, high-quality solutions for common canine health issues aligns with our vision of supporting brands that drive meaningful impact. Dope Dog's dedication to transparency and product efficacy sets them apart in the pet wellness space, and we are proud to support their mission to bring relief and comfort to dogs everywhere.

team.name: Michael Benatar
team.title: Co-Founder & CEO
team.bio: Michael co-founded Dope Dog in 2017 and serves as its CEO. He has a diverse background in media and production, having worked as an air talent/producer at Clear Channel and a fashion photographer. Michael has a degree in Cinematography and Film/Video Production and is also Klaviyo-certified, bringing both creative and technical expertise to the business.

team.name: Erin Mastropietro
team.title: Co-Founder & COO
team.bio: Erin co-founded Dope Dog and is the driving force behind its operations. With a passion for building customer-focused brands, she plays a critical role in product development and marketing strategy. Erin is also an advocate for women in business and has been featured in numerous media outlets for her leadership and entrepreneurial insights.

name: Enrich Scholars
description: Platform connecting underrepresented scholars with mentors, internships, and career development opportunities.
tagline: Transforming college potential into real-world success
longDescription:
Enrich is a platform designed to support scholars by providing them with the resources, guidance, and community necessary for academic and professional success. Focused on helping underrepresented students, Enrich offers a comprehensive network that connects scholars with mentors, internships, and career development opportunities, empowering them to navigate their educational and career paths with confidence.

At Evolution, we recognize the immense potential of Enrich in addressing the gap in academic support for underrepresented students. Their commitment to fostering equitable access to education and career development aligns perfectly with our investment focus on companies that drive meaningful societal impact while delivering scalable solutions to pressing challenges.

team.name: Alfonso Carney III
team.title: CEO
team.bio: Alfonso leads Enrich Scholars with a passion for transforming college potential into real-world success. Having grown up between Washington, DC, and Manhattan, he has a deep understanding of the social and professional challenges faced by people of color. With a background in Consumer Finance at RedRock Financial and as a Management Consultant at Publicis, he holds degrees in Economics from Amherst College and a JD/MBA from the University of Virginia.

team.name: Georges Clement
team.title: Chief Product Officer
team.bio: Georges is an experienced entrepreneur and product manager, with a Master's in Public Policy from Harvard Kennedy School. Previously, he founded JustFix and worked as a Product Manager at General Assembly. Recognized as a Forbes 30 Under 30 in Law & Policy, Georges brings a wealth of experience in social impact and product development to Enrich Scholars.

team.name: Joshua Zemke
team.title: Chief Technology Officer
team.bio: Josh has over a decade of experience in professional software development, including roles at Target and MyAlerts, where he modernized warehouse distribution systems and optimized product recommendations. He is passionate about using technology to build connections and support personal growth, contributing his expertise to the technical direction of Enrich Scholars.

team.name: Eric Cole
team.title: Head of Partnerships & Key Accounts
team.bio: Eric has nearly 30 years of experience in senior management roles within the financial services industry, including working for Fidelity Investments and founding his own company. With a background in Business Administration and Organizational Psychology, he is instrumental in building partnerships for Enrich. Eric also has a passion for competitive skiing, sailing, and managing a rap rock band of Berklee college alumni.

name: Eqvista
description: Comprehensive equity management platform for cap tables, share issuance, 409A valuations, and company incorporations.
tagline: Manage equity efficiently — from cap table to $1 trillion AUA
longDescription:
Eqvista is a comprehensive equity management platform that helps companies manage cap tables, issue shares, and conduct valuations like 409A assessments. The platform is designed to simplify the process for startups, growing businesses, and large corporations, providing tools for share issuance, financial analysis, and reporting. It also offers services like company incorporation and advanced features such as waterfall analysis for tracking equity dilution and exit scenarios.

At Evolution, we recognized Eqvista's potential to streamline complex equity management processes. Its scalable, user-friendly platform aligned with our commitment to investing in solutions that empower startups to grow efficiently.

team.name: Tomas Milar
team.title: Founder & CEO
team.bio: Tomas is a seasoned entrepreneur with vast experience in founding multiple startups and managing thousands of company incorporations. He established one of the largest company secretary services in Hong Kong and has grown IncParadise into a major registered agent in Nevada. His vision for Eqvista is to manage equity efficiently and reach $1 trillion in assets under administration within a few years.

team.name: Colin McCrea
team.title: CFO & Head of Valuation
team.bio: Colin is a certified valuation analyst (CVA) who manages Eqvista's valuation and corporate taxation teams. He has experience in taxation and auditing for small to medium-sized companies in both the US and Asia. Colin holds an Enrolled Agent accreditation with the IRS and played a key role in the acquisition of IncParadise.

team.name: Martin Bargl
team.title: Chief Technology Officer
team.bio: Martin brings over a decade of IT experience, having managed global IT projects from scratch to post-acquisition. He was instrumental in automating operations for companies like IncParadise and Startupr. At Eqvista, he focuses on enhancing the company's technological infrastructure.

team.name: Shilki Eesha
team.title: Chief Compliance Officer
team.bio: Shilki is an expert in financial crimes and regulatory compliance. She played a significant role in the launch of Cheqly, a neobank for SMEs, and oversees regulatory compliance across Eqvista and Cheqly's operations in the US and Hong Kong.

team.name: Tom Novotny
team.title: Chief Growth Officer
team.bio: Tom is a serial entrepreneur with a strong track record in building and scaling businesses. One of his companies was acquired by a publicly traded company, showcasing his expertise in business development. At Eqvista, Tom focuses on strategic partnerships and driving global growth.

team.name: Jakub Vele
team.title: Marketing Director
team.bio: Jakub brings over a decade of experience in digital marketing and brand strategy to Eqvista. He has worked on improving customer experience and expanding the company's digital presence. His previous collaborations with Tomas Milar include successful projects at Startupr and IncParadise.

name: Fanalyze
description: The fastest way to get sports data — one platform to consolidate all your fantasy teams and track player performance.
tagline: The fastest way to get sports data
longDescription:
Fanalyze is a comprehensive platform for fantasy sports players, allowing them to consolidate all their fantasy teams in one place. Their platform uses a specialized algorithm to streamline sports analysis, enabling users to quickly analyze and track player performance, making fantasy sports more accessible and efficient.

At Evolution, we see significant value in Fanalyze's innovative approach to enhancing the fantasy sports experience. Their focus on simplifying complex data into actionable insights aligns with our mission to support companies that drive innovation and improve user experiences across diverse communities.

team.name: Juan Juan
team.title: CEO & Co-Founder
team.bio: Juan is the CEO and Co-Founder of Fanalyze. He has a background in marketing, with a BS in Marketing from San Jose State University. With over 15 years of experience in web design and mobile app development, Juan has worked with numerous startups and prominent companies such as Apple and Schwab, bringing a wealth of experience in both technical and strategic roles to Fanalyze.

team.name: Chris Longboy
team.title: CTO & Co-Founder
team.bio: Chris is the CTO and Co-Founder of Fanalyze. He has played a key role in developing the technical foundation of the company's search engine and sports data platform. With expertise in backend architecture and product development, Chris ensures the seamless integration of data analytics to deliver real-time insights for fantasy sports and sports betting users.

name: Fasten
description: Interoperability platform connecting 40,000+ U.S. health systems — basically Plaid for healthcare.
tagline: Plaid for healthcare — seamless medical record sharing at scale
longDescription:
Fasten Health is an interoperability platform enabling patients to share medical records with trusted organizations — it's basically Plaid for healthcare. We connect to over 40,000 U.S. health systems via integrations with 40 major EHR platforms, providing seamless access to medical data without record releases or manual processes.

Fasten Health is revolutionizing healthcare data access with a single, unified API that enables seamless medical record sharing across thousands of health systems. Designed for clinical researchers, digital health platforms, and patient recruitment agencies, Fasten eliminates the friction of integrating with fragmented systems and brings healthcare interoperability within reach.

Founder and CEO Jason Kulatunga brings over a decade of experience designing secure, compliant cloud infrastructures across HIPAA, SOC, PCI, and FedRAMP standards. His deep understanding of regulatory complexity is baked into Fasten's architecture, making it a trusted partner for data-driven healthcare organizations navigating today's interoperability mandates.

team.name: Jason Kulatunga
team.title: Founder & CEO
team.bio: Jason has 15 years of experience building HIPAA, SOC, PCI, and FedRAMP-compliant cloud architectures. He has led enterprise-scale projects that solve the same security, interoperability, and compliance challenges Fasten addresses today. His deep technical expertise in compliant infrastructure, combined with his involvement in industry standards groups like HL7, the Sequoia Project, and the CARIN Alliance, helps keep Fasten ahead of the curve on both infrastructure and evolving regulations.

name: Fraxura
description: Ready-made reduction system for arm and wrist fractures — simplifying bone alignment for medical professionals.
tagline: Advancing fracture treatment in emergency rooms across the U.S.
longDescription:
Fraxura is a company that offers a ready-made reduction system specifically designed for arm and wrist bone fractures. Their innovative system simplifies the process of bone alignment and stabilization, making it easier for medical professionals to provide effective treatment, ultimately improving patient outcomes.

At Evolution, we recognize the tremendous value in Fraxura's commitment to advancing medical technology. Their focus on creating a user-friendly yet highly effective solution for a common medical issue aligns with our dedication to supporting companies that drive innovation and improve healthcare accessibility.

team.name: Geoff Skraber
team.title: CEO & Chief Creative Officer
team.bio: Geoff is the founder and CEO of Fraxura, which he launched after identifying a need for a more efficient fracture reduction system during his 30+ years as an orthopedic technician. His background at UC Davis helped him develop a product aimed at streamlining the treatment of arm and wrist fractures, which he first prototyped in his kitchen. Through his leadership, Fraxura has gained traction in emergency rooms across the U.S., starting with a contract from UC Davis Health.

team.name: Sandie Domerofski
team.title: Controller & Consultant
team.bio: Sandie plays a key role in Fraxura's financial and operational management as the company's Controller. Her expertise in consultancy and financial controls supports the company's growth as it expands its product into the healthcare market. Sandie also provides advisory services to help the company stay on course financially during its early stages of growth.

team.name: Wes Lemos
team.title: Tech / Digital / Marketing
team.bio: Wes leads the digital and marketing strategies at Fraxura. His expertise in technology and marketing is instrumental in elevating Fraxura's presence in the healthcare market. Wes brings a wealth of experience from his prior ventures, helping to drive Fraxura's digital transformation.

team.name: Aaron Rines
team.title: Advisor / Consultant
team.bio: Aaron acts as a strategic advisor to Fraxura, offering guidance on business development and partnerships. With his consulting experience, Aaron contributes valuable insights that help shape the company's direction and growth. His advisory role supports Fraxura's mission to advance fracture treatment.

name: Fuel AI
description: Democratized AI data platform connecting developers with 'Bounty Hunters' who contribute real-world photos, videos, audio, and text.
tagline: Grounding AI in real-world data — one bounty hunter at a time
longDescription:
Fuel AI is a cutting-edge platform that connects AI developers with everyday individuals, known as "Bounty Hunters," who contribute diverse data like photos, videos, audio, and text files. This innovative, democratized approach allows people from all walks of life to participate in AI development while earning money, making AI more accessible and grounded in real-world data.

At Evolution, we value Fuel AI's commitment to inclusivity in the tech space. By leveraging a broad range of user-contributed data, they create a more representative and accessible AI landscape. This aligns with our mission to support companies that push the boundaries of innovation while fostering greater participation and diversity in technology.

team.name: Virginia Puccio
team.title: Co-Founder & CEO
team.bio: Virginia is the Co-Founder and CEO of Fuel AI. She has a deep understanding of the data challenges faced by AI companies, particularly in sourcing unique, high-quality datasets required to train AI models. Her leadership focuses on enabling AI builders to access custom data through the platform's network of "bounty hunters," facilitating efficient data collection that fuels AI development.

team.name: Jon Nam
team.title: Co-Founder & COO
team.bio: Jon is the Co-Founder and COO of Fuel AI. He works closely with Virginia in overseeing the operational aspects of the company, focusing on scaling the bounty hunter network and optimizing the delivery of custom data solutions. Jon's expertise lies in managing the intersection of AI technology and marketplace operations, ensuring seamless coordination between AI builders and data providers.

name: iDentical
description: 3D-printed, drill-free dental implants — transforming tooth replacement with precision, speed, and patient comfort.
tagline: The drill-free dental implant
longDescription:
iDentical is a pioneering company in the field of dental technology, offering advanced solutions for creating 3D-printed, drill-free dental implants. Their innovative approach combines cutting-edge 3D printing technology with a patient-centered focus, allowing for more precise, efficient, and comfortable dental procedures. iDentical's solutions are transforming the dental industry by reducing treatment times and improving outcomes for patients and practitioners alike.

At Evolution, we see iDentical Dental Solutions as a game-changer in the dental industry. Their commitment to leveraging 3D printing technology to simplify and enhance dental procedures aligns perfectly with our mission to support companies that drive technological innovation and improve quality of life. iDentical's focus on patient-centric care and efficiency makes them a valuable partner in shaping the future of dental health.

team.name: Iris Wedeking
team.title: Founder & CEO
team.bio: Iris founded iDentical in 2018 and currently serves as the CEO. She has played a pivotal role in driving the company's vision of creating 3D-printed, personalized dental implants. Under her leadership, iDentical has raised significant funding and has become a key player in the dental technology space, focusing on innovative solutions for tooth replacement.

team.name: David Sanderson
team.title: Vice President of R&D
team.bio: David serves as the VP of Research & Development at iDentical, bringing 25 years of leadership experience in R&D, Operations, and Quality within the medical device industry. Throughout his career, David has managed R&D teams at renowned companies including Boston Scientific, Xtent, and BioCardia. His expertise ensures the successful development and delivery of groundbreaking medical technologies.

team.name: Mike Finke
team.title: Director of Implant Design
team.bio: Mike is the Director of Implant Design at iDentical, where he developed the patented implant design process used in clinical research and oversees the innovation pipeline to expand its applications. With over 10 years in the dental technology industry, he has extensive experience designing and implementing digital workflows that entail 3D printing, ensuring iDentical stays at the forefront of dental advancements.

name: ISC
description: Using naturally occurring microorganisms to create sustainable biological solutions for invasive species in aquatic, forestry, and agricultural environments.
tagline: Biological solutions for a world under invasion.
longDescription:
Invasive Species Corporation (ISC) addresses the economic and ecological threats posed by invasive species, which cost the global economy over $420 billion annually. The company uses naturally occurring microorganisms to create sustainable biological solutions for invasive species in aquatic, forestry, and agricultural environments, reducing reliance on harmful chemicals. ISC's mission is to protect biodiversity and ecosystems by pioneering eco-friendly and scalable interventions that target invasive species affecting critical natural resources.

Evolution recognized ISC's innovative approach to invasive species control as a significant advancement in ecological and environmental health. ISC's biologically driven solutions align with Evolution's mission to support sustainable technologies that address pressing global issues. The company's ability to develop targeted, eco-friendly alternatives to toxic chemicals, alongside partnerships and expertise in biologics, presented an outstanding opportunity for Evolution to invest in a leader driving real, scalable change in biodiversity preservation.

team.name: Pam Marrone
team.title: Founder & Executive Chair
team.bio: As the Executive Chair and Co-founder, Dr. Marrone is a veteran in biological pest management, with over 30 years leading bioag companies, including Marrone Bio Innovations. She has a robust history in launching bio-based solutions and guiding successful exits for bioag startups. Dr. Marrone is a Cornell and North Carolina State University alumna and serves on multiple boards in agriculture and biotechnology.

team.name: Jim Boyd
team.title: Founder & CEO
team.bio: A seasoned CFO and co-founder, Boyd brings 21 years of financial leadership experience across five public companies, including time as CFO at Marrone Bio Innovations. He excels in investor relations, finance, and strategic planning, providing essential insights and decision-making for ISC's financial and operational success.

team.name: Amit Vasavada
team.title: Chief Science Officer
team.bio: Chief Scientific Advisor at ISC, Dr. Vasavada holds a Ph.D. in Applied Microbiology and brings extensive expertise in bioproducts for agriculture, food, and animal health. With over 35 years in research and development, he is instrumental in ISC's biomanufacturing and biological innovation efforts.

team.name: Jim Gollub
team.title: VP of Business Development
team.bio: Specializing in innovation-driven economic strategy, Gollub supports ISC's mission by engaging stakeholders in the invasive species control market. He has a background in shaping economic strategies globally for various sectors and helps ISC in scaling solutions through collaboration.

team.name: Peter Kennedy
team.title: Acting CFO
team.bio: Peter Kennedy, a former partner at Fulcrum Capital, has deep expertise in sustainable investing, with a focus on agriculture, recycling, and healthcare innovations for underserved markets. His impactful investments include Marrone Bio Innovations and Terracycle, reflecting his dedication to environmentally responsible and socially impactful ventures.

name: Javlin Concepts
description: Designing and manufacturing advanced tactical gear with a focus on operator comfort, modularity, and maneuverability for military and law enforcement.
tagline: Advanced tactical gear engineered for those who serve.
longDescription:
Javlin Concepts is a company specializing in designing and manufacturing advanced tactical gear, with a particular focus on maximizing operator comfort, modularity, and maneuverability. Their flagship product, the Javlin Adaptive Carrier, is built to address the specific needs of military and law enforcement professionals, ensuring superior performance in the field.

At Evolution, we see great potential in Javlin Concepts' dedication to enhancing the safety and efficiency of those who serve. Their commitment to innovation and user-centered design strongly aligns with our mission to support companies that deliver impactful solutions.

team.name: Boston Bonn
team.title: Founder & CEO
team.bio: Boston Bonn is the founder and CEO of Javlin Concepts, a company specializing in custom plastic extrusions and components. With a background in engineering and product design, Boston plays a key role in developing innovative solutions for their clients' product needs. Under his leadership, Javlin Concepts focuses on optimizing functionality and efficiency across various industries.

name: Kids Care Finder
description: The only childcare platform tackling cost, supply, and access — connecting parents with providers through AI matching, nanny share, and automated enrollment tools.
tagline: Every child deserves great care. Every family deserves to find it.
longDescription:
Kids Care Finder is a game-changing childcare platform that connects parents with all the child-related services they need for their kids in one place. It is the only childcare platform addressing the root cause issues that make up the childcare crisis, which are cost, supply, and access. The platform helps reduce costs and grow supply with patent pending features like nanny share, provider administrative tools, and licensing support guides, and helps improve access by matching the right families with the right providers, through comprehensive filtering and AI matching technology.

At Evolution, we invested in Kids Care Finder because of its innovative approach to solving the U.S. childcare crisis with a one-stop platform that seamlessly connects parents with providers. With patent-pending features like NannyShare and automated enrollment management, the platform simplifies childcare logistics while unlocking new revenue opportunities for providers.

team.name: Olivia Rutman
team.title: Founder & CEO
team.bio: Olivia Rutman spent 15 years in the banking industry with Wells Fargo before taking the leap of faith to leave to start her own tech company. In banking, Olivia held a number of different roles across in sales, leadership, and enablement, and is well versed in both Retail and Commercial Banking. Olivia is a born executor who excels in problem solving, change management, training and go-to-market activities, and improving sales effectiveness. That experience, coupled with her own childcare struggles as the mom of three young boys, gave her the skills and passion needed to launch Kids Care Finder, a revolutionary childcare platform disrupting the care industry.

name: Knomee
description: Personalized financial wellness platform that helps users build a comprehensive financial identity and connect with trusted advisors aligned to their values.
tagline: Financial wellness built around who you are.
longDescription:
Knomee is a platform that provides personalized financial wellness services by helping users create a comprehensive financial identity. This identity is based on their values, goals, and financial situations, and it connects them with trusted financial advisors who can offer tailored guidance. Knomee's mission is to empower individuals to make informed financial decisions that align with what truly matters to them.

At Evolution, we recognize the transformative potential of Knomee's approach to financial wellness. Their focus on personalization and value-driven financial planning resonates with our commitment to supporting companies that empower underrepresented communities by offering meaningful and impactful solutions.

team.name: Marla Sofer
team.title: Founder & CEO
team.bio: Marla Sofer has an extensive background in financial services, having worked with companies such as BlackRock, Lending Club, and Microsoft before founding Knomee. She is passionate about personalizing financial services and empowering customers to take control of their financial identities. Marla launched Knomee with a vision to help individuals share their financial data consensually, aligning their values and behaviors with the services they need.

team.name: Sonja Strzoda
team.title: Financial Industry Change Agent
team.bio: Sonja Strzoda brings a wealth of experience in wealth and asset management, community banking, and government collaboration. Her leadership at NuVision Federal Credit Union and involvement with WISE (Women Investing in Security and Education) highlights her commitment to financial empowerment and inclusivity. At Knomee, Sonja contributes to the mission of making financial wellness accessible to diverse communities.

team.name: John Pearce
team.title: Finance & Operations
team.bio: John Pearce is responsible for managing Knomee's financial and operational functions. His role involves ensuring the company's financial stability while streamlining operations for growth. John brings a wealth of experience in finance, contributing to Knomee's mission of transforming the relationship between individuals and financial services.

team.name: Tim Lin
team.title: Data Science
team.bio: Tim Lin leads Knomee's data science initiatives, leveraging advanced analytics to personalize financial services for users. His work focuses on using data to optimize customer experiences and enhance the predictive capabilities of Knomee's platform. Tim's expertise ensures that the company's data-driven approach meets the unique needs of its users.

team.name: Meghaan Lurtz, PhD
team.title: Behavioral Psychology Advisor
team.bio: Meghaan Lurtz provides insights into behavioral psychology to help shape Knomee's approach to financial wellness. Her academic expertise ensures that the platform incorporates human behavior principles, making it more effective in guiding users toward better financial decisions. Meghaan's contributions help Knomee focus on long-term financial behavior changes for its users.

team.name: Ilan Davidovici
team.title: Customer Experience Advisor
team.bio: Ilan Davidovici is a thought leader in customer experience and advises Knomee on creating meaningful interactions between users and financial providers. His focus is on improving customer engagement and satisfaction, which are core to Knomee's personalized approach to financial services. Ilan's guidance ensures the platform delivers a seamless and effective customer experience.

team.name: Beto Pallares, PhD, MBA
team.title: Growth Advisor
team.bio: Beto Pallares supports Knomee's growth strategy by advising on business expansion and market penetration. With a background in entrepreneurship and venture capital, Beto helps guide the company as it scales its operations and reaches new customers. His expertise in scaling businesses ensures Knomee can expand while maintaining its customer-focused mission.

name: LaderaAI
description: GenAI analytics platform that puts the power of a personal data analyst in every business user's hands — ask questions in natural language and get instant insights.
tagline: Democratize data. Accelerate decisions.
longDescription:
Democratize data access and accelerate decision-making with Ladera AI's GenAI analytics platform that puts the power of a personal data analyst in the hands of every business user. Ask questions in natural language, get instant insights, and unlock the full potential of your company data for troubleshooting, problem-solving, and strategic planning.

At Evolution, we recognize the impact of Ladera's approach to addressing critical financial challenges. Their commitment to integrating financial education with practical solutions aligns with our mission to support innovative companies that foster economic empowerment and systemic transformation.

team.name: Samara Andrieux
team.title: Co-Founder & Chief Customer Officer
team.bio: Samara Andrieux co-founded Ladera with a mission rooted in personal experiences with the damaging effects of payday loans. With a background in Public Health, she recognized the link between financial stress and poor health outcomes and was driven to create a solution addressing economic stress. Her vision for Ladera focuses on improving the financial well-being of underserved communities by helping them break the payday lending cycle.

team.name: Dave Goulden
team.title: Co-Founder & CEO
team.bio: Dave Goulden, co-founder and CEO of Ladera, has over 23 years of experience in the ad tech industry. Initially an advisor to Samara Andrieux, he was inspired to join Ladera's mission to reduce debt for financially vulnerable individuals. Dave brings his deep expertise in product sales and business strategy to lead the company's vision of financial empowerment for credit union members.

team.name: Alexey Solovtsov
team.title: CTO
team.bio: As Ladera's Chief Technology Officer, Alexey Solovtsov is responsible for the company's AI-driven financial wellness platform. With a history of collaboration with Dave Goulden, Alexey shares a passion for applying technology to improve customer outcomes. He is instrumental in developing Ladera's innovative solutions that analyze cash flow and support credit unions in enhancing their services.

name: Ladris
description: AI-driven platform providing real-time and advanced scenario forecasts for emergency managers responding to wildfires, floods, and other natural disasters.
tagline: AI-powered foresight for emergency response.
longDescription:
Ladris is a pioneering company that uses AI-driven models to provide real-time and advanced "what-if" scenario forecasts for emergency managers. Their platform enables data-driven decision-making in disaster response, focusing on events like wildfires, floods, and other natural calamities. By offering actionable insights and predictive analytics, Ladris helps emergency personnel optimize their strategies for evacuations, mitigation efforts, and overall disaster preparedness, enhancing community resilience and safety.

At Evolution, we see immense value in Ladris' ability to revolutionize disaster management through their cutting-edge AI technology. Their commitment to empowering emergency managers with real-time insights aligns with our mission to support innovative solutions that address critical global challenges. By improving disaster readiness and response, Ladris is making a meaningful impact on saving lives and minimizing risks in vulnerable areas.

team.name: Leo Zlimen
team.title: Founder & CEO
team.bio: Leo Zlimen has been leading Ladris since its inception, where he is responsible for driving corporate strategy and go-to-market initiatives. Prior to founding Ladris, he worked as a software and data engineer, and his work earned him recognition such as the Berkeley Lipson Prize. He holds a Bachelor's degree from UC Berkeley, bringing a strong foundation in both technical and leadership roles.

team.name: Bowen Kyle
team.title: CTO
team.bio: As the Chief Technology Officer at Ladris, Bowen Kyle oversees product strategy and AI development. He has extensive expertise in applied mathematics, machine learning, and systems integration, and is dedicated to turning cutting-edge technologies into practical, real-world applications. Bowen's experience in bridging technical innovations with operational needs makes him integral to Ladris' success.

team.name: Igor Zlimen, PhD
team.title: VP of Engineering
team.bio: With over four decades of experience in software engineering, Igor Zlimen serves as Vice President of Engineering at Ladris. His expertise includes the design and development of database software systems, and he has contributed to various significant projects across industries. Igor holds a Ph.D. in nuclear physics and has a rich background in applying his knowledge to complex technical challenges.

team.name: Stefanie Fenton
team.title: VP of Product and Customer Success
team.bio: Stefanie Fenton brings 25 years of experience in software development and business strategy to her role as Vice President of Product and Customer Success at Ladris. She is known for building strong partnerships and high-performing teams, with a focus on product management, business development, and account management. Her leadership is key in fostering customer satisfaction and delivering product excellence.

name: Matrubials
description: Biotech company harnessing the antimicrobial properties of human milk peptides to develop novel therapeutics targeting infectious diseases like bacterial vaginosis.
tagline: Nature's blueprint for next-generation antimicrobials.
longDescription:
Matrubials is a biotech company focused on developing milk-inspired therapeutics to combat infectious diseases. They harness the antimicrobial properties of human milk peptides to create treatments that address the growing issue of antimicrobial resistance. Their initial focus is on treating bacterial vaginosis, a condition that causes recurrent infections and long-term health complications for women of reproductive age.

At Evolution, we recognize Matrubials' potential to revolutionize the treatment of infectious diseases with their innovative approach. Their work aligns with our mission to support groundbreaking solutions that address critical health challenges, particularly those that impact underrepresented communities.

team.name: Ishita M. Shah, Ph.D.
team.title: Co-Founder & CEO
team.bio: Dr. Ishita Shah is a co-founder and the CEO of Matrubials. She has a strong background in microbiology, chemistry, and food science, with expertise drawn from over a decade of research at the University of California, Davis. Dr. Shah leads the company's mission to develop milk-inspired antimicrobial therapies, particularly targeting women's health, starting with bacterial vaginosis.

team.name: J. Bruce German, Ph.D.
team.title: Co-Founder
team.bio: Dr. Bruce German is a co-founder of Matrubials and serves as a professor of Food Science and Technology at UC Davis. He is also the Director of the Foods for Health Institute. Dr. German's research focuses on the role of milk in human health and the potential of milk's bioactive molecules as therapeutic agents.

team.name: David A. Mills, Ph.D.
team.title: Co-Founder
team.bio: Dr. David Mills is a co-founder and holds the Shields Endowed Chair in Dairy Food Science at UC Davis. His expertise in microbiomes, probiotics, and dairy science helps drive the development of Matrubials' antimicrobial peptide technology, aiming to combat bacterial infections through safe and selective therapies.

team.name: Carlito B. Lebrilla, Ph.D.
team.title: Co-Founder
team.bio: Dr. Carlito Lebrilla is a Distinguished Professor of Chemistry at UC Davis and a co-founder of Matrubials. He is renowned for his work on glycobiology and mass spectrometry, contributing crucial insights into the molecular components of milk that can be harnessed for therapeutic purposes.

name: MedDefend
description: Healthcare technology platform using AI and data analytics to prevent medical errors and improve patient safety.
tagline: Protecting Patients. Empowering Providers.
longDescription:
MedDefend is a healthcare technology company that provides innovative patient safety solutions designed to protect against medical errors, improve clinical workflows, and enhance overall patient outcomes.

Their flagship platform focuses on automating error prevention, managing risk, and ensuring regulatory compliance in healthcare settings. By utilizing advanced data analytics and machine learning, MedDefend helps healthcare organizations detect potential issues before they occur, significantly reducing the incidence of medical errors and improving patient safety.

MedDefend's commitment to reducing preventable harm and improving patient outcomes represents a transformative solution that simplifies healthcare access and decision-making for patients by integrating AI-driven tools and community support into the platform.

team.name: Sarah Porter
team.title: Co-Founder & CEO
team.bio: Sarah Porter is the Co-Founder and CEO of MedDefend, a company focused on patient empowerment and healthcare navigation. She has a strong background in healthcare technology and leadership, previously holding positions at Coviance and State Farm. Sarah's vision for MedDefend is to simplify healthcare access and decision-making for patients by integrating AI-driven tools and community support into the platform.

team.name: Jeremy Mitchell
team.title: Co-Founder
team.bio: Jeremy Mitchell is the Co-Founder of MedDefend, a company focused on medical education services based in Des Moines. He played a key role in launching the company, helping to shape its vision of improving access to vital healthcare information. His leadership at MedDefend reflects his commitment to leveraging technology for better medical education and patient outcomes.

name: Mimoto
description: AI-powered cybersecurity that validates users by behavior, not credentials, for real-time threat detection and response.
tagline: Security based on who you are, not what you know.
longDescription:
Mimoto is an AI-powered cybersecurity company that delivers continual validation for access management and threat detection and response based on a specific person, not a credential, for real-time defensive responses before damage is done.

The Mimoto secret sauce is its ability to adapt on the fly the combination of algorithms used based on the available data streams. Its combination of anomaly detection and advanced pattern matching enables drastically fewer false positives than traditional cybersecurity solutions.

At Evolution, we invested in Mimoto because they are redefining how businesses protect their systems through behavioral security. Their innovative approach moves beyond traditional credentials, using advanced technology to verify users based on unique behavioral patterns.

team.name: Kris Bondi
team.title: Co-Founder & CEO
team.bio:
In prior executive leadership roles, Mimoto CEO & Co-founder Kris Bondi made a name for herself as a category creator and GTM strategist that significantly increased adoption and positioned companies. She contributed to seven acquisitions and two IPO filings, and is best known for making "serverless" a movement and a category.

Kris is a pioneer in applying AI to real-world problems. As CMO of Neura, an Israel-based AI company, she championed the concept of products proactively interacting with people. This experience with a neural network of digital doubles has enabled her to determine where Mimoto's groundbreaking technology can immediately address an organization's most critical internal security gaps. Among her career highlights is serving as a stringer for the Harrisburg Patriot covering Nelson Mandela's first speech in the United States.

team.name: David Charboneau
team.title: Co-Founder & CTO
team.bio:
Mimoto CTO and Co-founder David Charboneau is a repeat cofounder with a rich background in building products at scale. His 20+ years of experience in the software industry spans from startups to Fortune 500 enterprises.

David served as Director of Consulting at Quansight, the machine learning and data science consultancy co-founded by Travis Oliphant. David and Travis went on to co-found OpenTeams, which specializes in data science and high-performance computing. He was also a founding member of the Foundation Services Team and a founding member of Bank of America Merrill Lynch's Quartz Team.

David holds 5 patents in areas covering distributed graph databases, content indexing with RDF, and user experience tools. He resides in North Carolina and is active in the global open source community.

name: MV
description: AI-native operating system for field sales and logistics teams, automating routing, orders, delivery, and payment.
tagline: Your ERP and CRM complement.
longDescription:
MV AI is an AI-native operating system for field sales and logistic teams. The company streamlines and automates all parts of the field sales process, from routing and order processing to delivery and payment.

Currently, over 600,000 field sales teams are using fragmented, manual processes to run their organization. MV is changing that. Our routing system alone saves our clients on avg. 12 hours a week.

At Evolution, we recognize how MV Sales & Logistics is solving critical pain points in wholesale distribution. Founded by Pedro Peroni, who comes from a 40-year family background in wholesale distribution and has 15+ years of international sales experience, the company brings deep industry expertise to modernizing sales and logistics.

team.name: Pedro Peroni
team.title: Co-Founder & CEO
team.bio:
Pedro Peroni, Co-Founder and CEO of MV, grew up immersed in the family business, which was the main distributor of Gatorade in Colombia. From a young age, he dedicated summers to working in field sales for Gatorade, trading summer camps for firsthand experience in the industry.

This hands-on journey not only exposed him to incredible opportunities in the distribution sector but also highlighted its significant challenges — many of which arise from outdated practices that can be revolutionized through technology. After diving deeper into the process and engaging with colleagues in the food and beverage industry, Pedro recognized a pressing need to automate and modernize these businesses. That realization led to the creation of MV.

team.name: Aida Zamora
team.title: Technology Director
team.bio: Aida is the Technology Director of MV and leads the 8 developers and all R&D efforts. With 10 years of experience in the technology industry, Aida excels at creating innovative solutions to complex real-world problems. Prior to co-founding MV, Aida was the head of QA team at Frubana where she led a team that was focused on quality and control at one of the fastest growing technology companies in Latam.

team.name: Silvia Franco
team.title: Business Development
team.bio:
Silvia is a dynamic Business Development Specialist with a strong track record of driving growth and innovation across Latin America, the Caribbean, the U.S., and Canada. With a background in Business Administration and complementary studies in Sales and Marketing from Pontificia Universidad Javeriana, Silvia excels at identifying market opportunities and delivering tailored solutions for clients.

Over the course of her career, she's worked with leading global companies such as Oracle, where she exceeded demand generation quotas by connecting businesses with cutting-edge applications and software solutions. Silvia's journey also includes roles focused on trade marketing and innovation, where her strategic insights contributed to increased efficiency and successful product launches.

Outside the office, Silvia is passionate about exploring new cultures, continuously learning, and connecting with like-minded professionals. She brings her curiosity and interpersonal skills into every new challenge, helping companies build meaningful relationships and foster long-term growth.

team.name: Jerson Suaza
team.title: Systems Engineer
team.bio: Jerson Suaza is a Systems Engineer at MV, contributing his technical expertise to building and scaling the company's field sales and logistics platform.

name: My Panda
description: Personal assistant app connecting users with local helpers, known as Pandas, for flexible and fairly paid help with daily tasks.
tagline: Your personal assistant next door.
longDescription:
My Panda is a pioneering personal assistant app designed to address the time and support scarcity faced by women today. The app connects users with local helpers, known as Pandas, who provide flexible and fairly paid assistance with daily tasks. My Panda streamlines the process of requesting and receiving support for errands and chores through a secure, user-friendly platform.

At Evolution, we recognize the value of My Panda's approach to supporting women and local communities through practical assistance. Their commitment to enhancing daily life and creating job opportunities for local helpers aligns with our dedication to fostering innovation that addresses real societal challenges and empowers diverse entrepreneurs.

team.name: Tamara Lucas
team.title: Founder & CEO
team.bio: Tamara Lucas founded My Panda with a vision to create a service that connects neighbors to help with everyday tasks. Her background includes a Master's in Social Work from the University of Georgia, and she has a deep passion for community-building and offering flexible job opportunities. Tamara has led My Panda through its growth, building a hyperlocal service that supports both its users and local businesses.

team.name: Anna Hamilton
team.title: Operations
team.bio: Anna Hamilton manages operations at My Panda, ensuring the smooth functioning of the platform and overseeing the management of Pandas (personal assistants) who deliver on-demand services. With a focus on process optimization, Anna ensures that both the client-side experience and the backend logistics are aligned with the company's mission of community-driven support.

team.name: Chris Waterbury
team.title: Lead Developer & Chief Software Architect
team.bio: Chris Waterbury is responsible for the technical architecture and development of My Panda's app. With a background in physics and biology from the Georgia Institute of Technology, Waterbury has extensive experience in app development and has worked in various technology consulting roles prior to joining My Panda. He oversees the app's functionality, ensuring a user-friendly and reliable platform for both customers and Pandas.

team.name: Jonathan Richter
team.title: Head of Product
team.bio: Jonathan Richter leads product development at My Panda, focusing on enhancing user experience and expanding service offerings. He works closely with the development and operations teams to ensure that My Panda's product aligns with customer needs and market trends.

name: Admisio
description: Personalized college matching and step-by-step admissions guidance to help students unlock their full potential.
tagline: Simplify and Unlock College Admissions
longDescription:
Admisio provides powerful tools and personalized guidance to simplify college applications.

College matching helps students find the best schools based on their goals, budgets, and career path. Personalized roadmaps deliver customized checklists of tasks needed to meet each student's admission goals.

Essay assistance connects students with experts who craft compelling essays geared toward their dream schools. Private counselors with experience on both the college admission and counseling sides guide students every step of the way.

name: Cartwheel
description: AI-powered delivery management platform integrating in-house and third-party deliveries for enterprise brands.
tagline: Smarter delivery management for enterprise businesses
longDescription:
Cartwheel is a delivery management software that empowers businesses to efficiently manage their delivery operations through a hybrid approach that integrates in-house and third-party deliveries. The platform uses AI-driven tools for route optimization, real-time driver tracking, and automated delivery assignments, enabling businesses to reduce operational costs and enhance customer satisfaction.

At Evolution, we value Cartwheel's innovative approach to optimizing delivery operations. Their ability to seamlessly integrate technology with practical business solutions reflects our commitment to backing companies that not only drive efficiency but also empower businesses to better serve their communities.

team.name: Alex Vasilkin
team.title: Co-Founder & CEO
team.bio: Alex has been instrumental in guiding Cartwheel from its origins as a delivery service to becoming a leading provider of delivery management software. Under his leadership, Cartwheel has expanded its hybrid delivery solutions, helping enterprise brands improve efficiency and grow revenue.

team.name: Mike Borozdin
team.title: Technical Advisor
team.bio: Mike brings extensive experience from leadership roles at Google, DocuSign, and Microsoft. His engineering expertise helps Cartwheel strengthen its technical capabilities, ensuring the platform remains innovative and scalable.

team.name: Shalin Sheth
team.title: Industry Advisor
team.bio: A seasoned expert in the restaurant and food tech industries, Shalin has held key roles including Senior VP & GM of Olo Direct Ordering and Head of Delivery at Yelp Eat24. He guides Cartwheel in creating solutions for the evolving needs of enterprise restaurants.

team.name: John Hancock
team.title: Industry Advisor
team.bio: John brings operational expertise from Sweetgreen and Instacart, having overseen off-premises operations and led innovative delivery models at major brands. His knowledge is vital in helping Cartwheel improve delivery efficiency and optimize hybrid solutions.
